measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: QA cross-judge multi-session accuracy lift from the reasoning observations
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: The shipped qa-judge-harness.bench.test.ts does NOT wire the reasoning observations into recall (the SAME KG-05 structural gap, verified). Making a costed QA cross-judge measure a reasoning-ON lift requires FIRST (a) wiring the reasoning observations into the QA recall path AND (b) a costed reasoning pass over the corpus (the offline reason() seam needs a costed model — there is no keyless reasoner). That harness extension is beyond this regression-gate plan's scope. Therefore the costed QA cross-judge multi-session lift is an OPERATOR COSTED RE-RUN, scheduled after the QA harness is extended (a Phase-101 gap-closure or a follow-on plan). NO multi-session delta is quoted — quoting a guessed delta would be exactly the fabrication this gate exists to prevent.

honestyProtocol: Every number in GATE-REPORT.md traces to a committed JSON in this directory (read back from disk + asserted in the harness before quoting). The bench is keyless — no QA accuracy number is produced or quoted; the QA cross-judge cell is explicitly 'not measured — operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta. A post-write credential-shape sweep over the manifest JSONs is clean (no secret-key prefixes, bearer tokens, or credential field markers).
